editorial:
Ever wondered what would happen if you followed a weird urban legend from the internet? You get to see that play out with Ryan, a shy teen who is desperate to find his missing sister. He finds out she vanished while playing a creepy ritual called the Elevator Game, which supposedly sends you to a mirror world. The vibe is very tense and spooky, making you feel the dread as he steps into that lift. It starts off slow, but once he begins the ritual, the movie really picks up speed and keeps you guessing about what is actually happening around him.

What really works here is how the movie builds tension without relying on too many jump scares. The acting feels real, and the weirdness of the other dimension is handled well. Some parts might feel a bit slow in the middle, but the payoff is worth it. If you are into supernatural mysteries, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: At the end, Ryan finally makes it to the other side to save his sister. He discovers that the mirror world is a dangerous trap that tricks people into staying forever. After a scary fight with the entity controlling the lift, Ryan manages to pull his sister back into our world. They both escape just in time before the doors close for good, leaving the evil spirit trapped in the void.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves urban legends and creepy rituals.
